brief: Create an original, practical short conversation for US moms and parents about everyday life with babies and postpartum motherhood. Choose a fresh topic and angle each run, and vary topics across runs. Draw from a broad mix: newborn and baby care, feeding, safe sleep basics, soothing, routines, play, bonding, development and milestones, diapering, bathing, travel, postpartum recovery and wellbeing, realistic self-care, and asking for support. Keep content age-appropriate, cautious, evidence-aligned, and general. Do not diagnose, give individualized medical advice, or make unsupported health claims; suggest asking a pediatrician or qualified clinician when a personal health concern comes up. Use warm, natural American English. Include a brief safety reminder only when relevant.
